packages.name: 5-Day Hunza & Khunjerab Pass Trip
packages.best: Cheapest way to see Hunza and Khunjerab by road
itinerary: Overnight departure; breakfast in Mansehra, then over Babusar Pass past Lulusar Lake to Chilas.
Chilas to Hunza, stopping where three mountain ranges meet and at the Rakaposhi viewpoint.
Khunjerab day: Passu Cones, Hussaini Bridge and the Pakistan-China border at Khunjerab Pass.
Altit Fort and old Altit village, free time in Karimabad bazaar, then start the drive back south.
Back over Babusar Top with stops at Lulusar Lake and Naran, arriving in Lahore late at night.
good: Lowest published price in this comparison
Covers the classic trio: Karimabad, Passu and Khunjerab
watch: Two of five days are mostly driving, and the first starts with an overnight bus
The Babusar route is seasonal (roughly late May to October); outside that the trip must use the KKH
"From" price - ask what is included and how many share the vehicle

packages.name: Autumn Tour to Hunza ("Luxury")
packages.best: Autumn colours with all meals included
itinerary: Overnight departure from Lahore; breakfast in Mansehra and on up the KKH to Chilas.
Chilas to Hunza via the Nanga Parbat viewpoint, with a local-food lunch in Nagar.
Boat ride on Attabad Lake, then on to Khunjerab Pass and the China border.
Guided visits to Altit and Baltit forts and lunch in Karimabad, then back down to Chilas.
Long drive home, reaching Lahore in the early hours.
good: All three meals listed, and the Chilas hotel is named
Fits autumn colour (late September to October) into five days
watch: Only about two full days in Hunza itself
"Luxury" at this price - confirm the Hunza hotel name and whether transport is shared

packages.name: 6-Day Hunza & Naltar Valley Trip
packages.best: Adding Naltar to a short Hunza trip
itinerary: Midnight departure from Islamabad; breakfast in Besham and on to Chilas by evening.
To Hunza: Rakaposhi viewpoint, Baltit and Altit forts, and sunset at Eagle's Nest.
Khunjerab Pass, with stops at Attabad Lake and Gulmit on the way.
Across to Naltar Valley for the lakes and ski area, then down to Gilgit for the night.
Gilgit back down the KKH to Besham.
Besham to Islamabad via Abbottabad.
good: Six days for under Rs 20,000 (published)
Eagle's Nest sunset and Naltar - two things short trips usually skip
watch: Breakfast only, so budget for lunch and dinner
The last stretch into Naltar is rough and needs a 4x4 - check it's included

packages.name: Hunza Valley & Khunjerab Pass Tour
packages.travel: Fly to Gilgit, return by road
packages.best: Seeing Upper Hunza properly, plus Fairy Meadows
itinerary: Arrive in Islamabad and transfer to your hotel.
Fly to Gilgit and drive up to Karimabad.
Baltit Fort, Karimabad bazaar and Altit Fort, then via Hopper to Gulmit.
Passu Glacier, Borith Lake and the Hussaini suspension bridge.
Full-day trip to Khunjerab Pass.
Chapursan Valley: horse or yak rides and, if it's on, a local polo match.
Gulmit down to Gilgit, with a stop at the Chinese cemetery.
Jeep from Raikot Bridge and hike up to Fairy Meadows.
Hike and jeep back down, then drive on to Besham.
Taxila Museum on the way back to Islamabad.
good: Includes Chapursan - rarely in Hunza packages
Full board, and the route mixes Hunza with Fairy Meadows
watch: The Gilgit flight is weather-dependent; ask what happens if it is cancelled
No price published - get the quote and the hotel names in writing

packages.name: Hunza Valley & Attabad Lake Tour
packages.best: Hunza plus Phander and Ghizer, without the long KKH drive
itinerary: Arrive in Islamabad and transfer to your hotel.
Fly to Gilgit and drive up to Karimabad.
Baltit and Altit forts.
Hopper Glacier, then Attabad Lake and on to Gulmit.
Hussaini Bridge, Borith Lake and Passu Glacier.
Full-day trip to Khunjerab Pass.
West through Gilgit to Gupis in Ghizer.
Day trip to Phander Valley and its lake.
Back to Gilgit for the bazaar.
Fly from Gilgit to Islamabad.
good: Flights both ways save around four days of road
Adds Ghizer (Gupis and Phander), which few Hunza tours do
watch: Two flight days means two chances of weather delays - keep a buffer day
No price published

packages.name: Pakistan Spring Blossom Tour
packages.best: Blossom season by road, with rafting
itinerary: Arrive in Islamabad and transfer to your hotel.
Up the KKH to Chilas, with lunch in Besham.
Chilas to Karimabad, stopping where three mountain ranges meet.
Baltit Fort, Karimabad bazaar and Altit Fort.
Hopper Glacier, then on to Gulmit in Upper Hunza.
Passu Glacier, Borith Lake and the suspension bridges.
Full-day trip to Khunjerab Pass.
White-water rafting on the upper Hunza River, then down to Gilgit.
Gilgit to Besham, with the Nanga Parbat viewpoint.
Taxila Museum on the way back to Islamabad.
good: No flights, so no cancellation risk
Paced well for blossom (late March to mid-April)
watch: Four of ten days are on the KKH
No price published

packages.name: Hunza Cherry Blossom Tour (fixed date)
packages.travel: Fly to Gilgit (road back-up), return by road
packages.best: A group departure run by a Hunza-based operator
itinerary: Arrive in Islamabad and transfer to your hotel.
Fly to Gilgit and drive to Hunza; if the flight is cancelled, drive to Chilas instead.
Karimabad: blossom, forts and the old town.
Hopper Valley, then on to Gojal (Upper Hunza).
Khunjerab Pass at 4,693m.
Passu, Gulmit and Ghulkin villages.
Long KKH drive down to Besham or Naran.
Taxila and Islamabad sightseeing.
Twin-city tour and departure.
good: Clear published price and dates (26 March to 3 April 2027 listed)
Each day lists drive time and altitude, and there's a stated plan B if the flight fails
watch: Priced in US dollars for foreign visitors; ask about a local rate
Dinner is not listed as included

packages.name: Hunza & Fairy Meadows Tour
packages.best: Hunza and Nanga Parbat in one trip
itinerary: Arrive in Islamabad.
Up the KKH to Chilas.
Jeep and short hike up to Fairy Meadows.
Hike to Nanga Parbat Base Camp and back.
Down from Fairy Meadows and on to Upper Hunza (Ghulkin, Passu or Gulmit).
Khunjerab Pass.
Ghulkin, Passu and Gulmit villages.
Via Hopper Valley to Karimabad.
Karimabad and central Hunza's heritage sites.
South via the KKH or Babusar Pass to Besham or Naran.
Taxila and an Islamabad city tour.
good: A full day at Nanga Parbat Base Camp, not just a night at Fairy Meadows
Full board and a gentle pace in Hunza
watch: Eleven days, and most of the return is on the road
No price published

packages.name: Hunza & Kalash Valley Tour
packages.best: The full overland loop: Swat, Kalash, Shandur, Hunza
itinerary: Arrive in Islamabad.
Drive to Peshawar.
On to Swat.
Swat to Chitral.
Into the Kalash valleys.
A day exploring Bumburet.
Over Shandur Pass to Phander.
Phander to Gilgit.
Gilgit to Karimabad.
A day around Karimabad.
Karimabad to Passu.
Khunjerab Pass and back to Passu.
Jeep day trip to Shimshal.
Over Babusar Pass to Naran.
Naran to Islamabad.
Departure.
good: Includes Shimshal and the Shandur crossing
Two nights in Passu for Upper Hunza
watch: Very little detail published - ask for inclusions, meals and hotels
Shandur and Babusar are summer-only passes

packages.name: Swat, Kalash, Hunza & Kaghan Jeep Tour
itinerary: Arrive in Rawalpindi and drive straight to Mingora, Swat.
Day trip to Kalam and back.
To Bumburet in the Kalash valleys (camping).
Birir valley and back to Bumburet (camping).
On to Mastuj (camping).
Over Shandur Pass to Phander (camping).
To Cher Qila in Punial (camping).
To Karimabad, Hunza.
Day trip to Khunjerab Pass.
Free day in Karimabad.
Down to Chilas.
Over Babusar Pass to Naran.
Back to Rawalpindi.
Airport transfer.
good: Skardu-based operator; jeeps suit the rough Chitral-Shandur road
Camping nights in the Kalash valleys and Ghizer
watch: Listed as 9 days, but the day plan runs 14 - confirm which is right
Five nights camping; no meals or price published

notes: UK travel advice (FCDO) warns against all travel on the KKH between Mansehra and Chilas. If that applies to you, pick a trip that flies to Gilgit or uses the Babusar road (open roughly late May to October).
